instruction: Please configure VS Code to hide all ".vscode" folders in the explorer view.

metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding .vscode folders in VS Code explorer. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify files.exclude setting contains '**/.vscode': true. Similar complexity to original task - single setting modification.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to hide .vscode folders in VS Code explorer
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly retrieves VS Code settings file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric (check_json_settings) correctly loads JSON and compares expected key-value pairs
Expected value structure is correct: files.exclude setting with **/.vscode: true is the proper VS Code setting to hide .vscode folders
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 for missing files or JSON parse errors
No postconfig needed: settings persist after saving in VS Code
Data flow is semantically correct: file retrieval -> JSON parsing -> key-value comparison
